title: One Open Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program per Customer
content:
A customer holds at most 1 Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program (CGM program) at a time across every tier, because a payer pays one CGM supply allowance per beneficiary per month.

## The rule

- A new CGM program is opened only when the customer has no CGM program in referral received, pending authorization, active or on hold status.
- A new referral, a new model or a new insurance for a customer with such a program is written as a program change on that program.
- A closed program does not count.

## Which existing programs count

| Status of the customer's existing CGM program | Counts toward the limit of 1 | A new CGM program can be opened |
|---|---|---|
| Referral received | Yes | No; the new referral is a program change on it |
| Pending authorization | Yes | No; written as a program change |
| Active | Yes | No; written as a program change |
| On hold | Yes | No; written as a program change |
| Closed | No | Yes |
| No CGM program at all | Not applicable | Yes |

## Points of judgement

- The limit runs across every tier: a program on the CGM Commercial PPO Program blocks a new program on the CGM Medicaid Program just as it blocks one on its own tier.
- A customer whose only CGM program is closed holds no program that counts, so a new CGM program can be opened for a new referral.
